fix(lanes): a mismatch that outlasts the /clear rewrite race draws the session-pane ⚠ (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.2d2)

A request whose Claude Code's record holds another session is the rewrite
race at first. Each session's run of such stamps is now held in memory,
keyed by the Claude Code that ran its client. A confirmed tick from that
process ends every run it opened, whatever the session. Once a run goes on
past the race (10 s), the bar's session-pane ⚠ names the session the record
holds, under a stable identity. The render line gains a mismatch fact.

fix(click): a drawn link reads as the daemon's one read, step by step (brandon-menus-sjhy.3c7) (#668)

* fix(click): a drawn link reads as the daemon's one read, step by step, and one gate holds back a driven bar's machine click (brandon-menus-sjhy.3c7)

The dispatch read stamps each step once: one that runs carries its leaf,
session and arguments; one refused carries the daemon's text for why and the
arguments that decoded. The fold is the one reader of step outcomes and the
one caller of the refusal owners. drawnClickOf and describeLink read through
readClick, so adjacent writes read as the batch that lands and a malformed
step as its own refusal beside the steps that run; effectsOf stays the wire
codec's inverse. The harness and the site hold a click back by one gate that
counts only steps that run, naming refused steps beside them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(click): a refused step and a handler's refusal are one Refusal, and a click is read once per reader (brandon-menus-sjhy.3c7)

The step's run takes only a step its read lets run, so the fold hands a
refused step's refusal straight to its owner. effectsOf throws a value
that does not decode with its link again, and spells the unknown verb and
the non-dispatch link as the daemon and drawnClickOf do. The driven-bar
hold takes the click its caller already read.

* fix(site): a copy-only click starts its clipboard write before the render it awaits (brandon-menus-sjhy.3c7)

A browser copies only while the click's gesture is live, and the spread
awaited the render first. The fold's and the session read's comments say
where a step is now refused, and the driven-bar hold names what its steps
do once each.

* refactor(click): an unknown verb's refusal has its own constructor beside a step's (brandon-menus-sjhy.3c7)

* test(click): the driven-bar hold beside a refused step is pinned by the reader's own case, not a new daemon boot (brandon-menus-sjhy.3c7)

fix(config): a click writes its home on the disk it read and proved; the book's folder is absent as presence says (candybar-testing-ihvy.5zt)

- ConfigHome carries the click's writable disk; the commit writes through it
  (writeAtomicOn), so a click's read, proof and write are one disk's. Undo
  keeps its own system-disk pair until the settings history takes a disk.
- bookIsFiled asks presence(): a book folder that is a regular file holds no
  book, and the loose book is read.
- holdsGit asks presence() and marks its no-silent-failure exception; the
  ascent carrying the failure is candybar-testing-ihvy.izc.sv9.

fix(config): a click's proof shares the render cache's installed layers and reads its home's disk (candybar-testing-ihvy.5zt)

- ConfigHome carries the installed-layer memo its loads share; the render
  cache lends its own through the verb context, so a click's proof checks no
  plugin the bar's last load already checked. The memo keys on definition
  text, so a lent memo serves no layer the borrower's disk does not hold.
- presence() reads ENOTDIR as absent, as the stat it replaced did: a path
  through a regular file holds nothing. The filesystem contract pins ENOTDIR.
- A click reads its home's text and the layers above on the disk its proof
  loads; config-file-store leaves FS_READERS.
- The lane edge's fileExists asks the same disk as its presence.
- stateFromLoad folds into loadFromDisk; keyLoad is module-private.

feat(config): a renderer loads config as a value over the filesystem port (candybar-testing-ihvy.5zt)

Every read a config load makes goes through the FilesystemReads it is
handed: the answers book, discovery, worktree links, plugin folders, each
layer and each definition. readConfigLoad (src/config/load.ts) is the load
as a value; the render cache builds state from it. Each definition is read
once per load, and the installed-plugin memo is an owned value keyed on
the texts, not module state keyed on a stat. The answers book's read moves
into Config, the state-file store into src/disk. Repo-approval cases move
to test/unit over the fake. Ten files leave FS_READERS; Config gets an
import rule.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(band): a switched-off band lane holds no follower process (candybar-animation-wbxz.w33)

The band mod stops its follow child on the daemon's SWITCHED_OFF answer
instead of keeping it alive to re-ask every 5s, and turning band (A) off
uninstalls the mod so sessions started afterwards never load it. An
uninstall of a mod that is not installed is the state off asks for, so it
is said rather than thrown.
